in_hindi.name: सिद्धेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: लोड़ ऑफ डीर्स्ट (lord of the perfected)

in_marathi.name: Siddesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the Lord of the Gods, the controller of all. Siddesh is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the word 'Sidh', which means accomplished, and 'Desh' which means land or realm. It is believed that this name represents the supreme being and the one who has achieved everything.
